title: FIPS gate missing: example/sess_init
description: src/providers/example/example_provider.c:140 — example_sess_init() has no gate call. The callback begins with op validation (if op != CRYPTO2DEV_OP_ENCRYPT ...) before any fips_gate() check. Per design rule 1c, framework-level gating in ioctl_init cannot substitute for per-callback gates. Anyone forking this skeleton will ship a non-gated sess_init. All gated callbacks in the example provider must call example_fips_gate() as their first executable statement.
